request: Activate the complete Kalaxy3 SAGE mandatory operating contract. Require current Git, GitHub, SAGE, and runtime authority before mutation; evidence-based selection and reuse of repository-owned components; composition manifests; capability-gap receipts; real runtime validation; failure diagnosis that records what failed, what should have been done, which existing component should have been used, why the actual path differed, and the reusable correction; measurable outcome, reuse, authority, failure, rework, and safety statistics; Git credential and history safety; and an operator-executed, visible, one-boundary-at-a-time Git/GitHub mutation gate. Downloaded implementation helpers may edit and validate repository files but may only inspect Git read-only and may not create or switch branches, stage, commit, push, pull, merge, rebase, reset, clean, delete refs, mutate GitHub, or deploy.
required_capability: Exactly one operator-executed Git or GitHub mutation proposal without execution.

candidates_considered.insufficiency: Manual prose does not enforce command count, boundary matching, digesting, validation evidence, or a blocked next boundary.

gap.missing_interface_or_behavior: A typed proposal builder matching the Phase 1 operator Git proposal schema.
gap.why_configuration_is_insufficient: Formatting conventions alone cannot enforce semantic command and boundary constraints.
gap.why_composition_is_insufficient: Existing workflow primitives either execute commands or write generic closeouts; neither guarantees non-execution of one mutation command.

proposed_primitive.responsibility: Build and write a schema-valid secret-free one-command operator mutation proposal and never execute it.
proposed_primitive.side_effects: Optional local proposal receipt write only.
proposed_primitive.idempotency: Deterministic for fixed inputs and timestamp.
proposed_primitive.logging: Boundary, command digest, exact scope, validation, and operator contract.
proposed_primitive.failure_mode: Invalid identifiers, command composition, credentials, or validation fail before proposal emission.

approval.rationale: The operator explicitly approved the Phase 2 least-authority safety-foundation gaps.
